question: What lies beyond the seventh ocean and what boundary mountain is described there?
premises: Outside the seventh ocean there is a golden land extending ten crores of yojanas.
Beyond it is described the Lokāloka mountain, different from the inhabited world.
That mountain is one hundred thousand yojanas high and ten thousand yojanas broad.
inference: The golden land beyond the seventh ocean ends at the Lokāloka mountain, which marks the boundary of the world.
plain_english: Beyond the seventh ocean lies a golden land extending ten crores of yojanas. After that is the Lokāloka mountain, one hundred thousand yojanas high and ten thousand yojanas broad.
